Author: Claude Opus 5
Description: Cut ingest latency and hide the remainder behind live progress. Collapsed the three full file transfers per upload (download - S3 re-upload - re-download) into one by skipping the S3 round trip for URLs already on our CloudFront and handing the downloaded bytes to the parser via a content-hash keyed cache; replaced the up-to-50k-char full-document blurb prompt with a compact TOC and opening-passage synopsis; added dedicated LLM and CPU thread pools so the blurb semaphore is no longer capped at ~6 by the default executor; moved blocking psycopg2 calls off the single shared worker event loop and switched vector inserts to execute_values.

Author: Claude Opus 5
Description: Navigate to /chat on submit instead of blocking on vector_embed_status COMPLETE. Added POST /new-rag-project/attach-note/ which inserts the notes stub, parks the note request in Redis and returns immediately so WeWeb can navigate, plus a try_fire_pending_note DEL-claim helper called from both the endpoint and finalize_batch_and_create_note so exactly one side dispatches rag_note_task regardless of which finishes first. Added utils/progress_events.py publishing named ingest and note stages onto the chat WebSocket channel already open on /chat, and raised the RAG barrier timeout from 12s to 90s now that users can type immediately on arrival.
